name: Shemeber
title: King of Zeboiim
summary: Shemeber was the king of Zeboiim, one of the five cities on the Jordan Plain. He was among the kings who rebelled against King Chedorlaomer of Elam after serving as his vassals for twelve years. He took part in the battle in the Valley of Siddim, where he and his allies were defeated.

keyEvents.title: Vassal under Chedorlaomer
keyEvents.description: Shemeber and the other kings on the Jordan Plain served King Chedorlaomer of Elam for twelve years before rebelling in the thirteenth year.

keyEvents.title: Alliance with the Kings of the Jordan Plain
keyEvents.description: Shemeber formed an alliance with Bera (king of Sodom), Birsha (king of Gomorrah), Shinab (king of Admah) and the king of Bela (Zoar) to fight against Kedorlaomer and his allies.

keyEvents.title: The Battle in the Valley of Siddim
keyEvents.description: Shemeber and his allies met Kedorlaomer and his four allied kings in battle at the Valley of Siddim (the Salt Sea valley), but were defeated.

keyEvents.title: Defeat and Flight
keyEvents.description: After the defeat, the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled and fell into the asphalt pits in the Valley of Siddim, while the survivors escaped to the mountains. The cities were plundered.

keyEvents.title: Abraham's Intervention
keyEvents.description: After the defeat, Abram (Abraham) rescued Lot and the other captives taken by Kedorlaomer, and brought back all the goods that had been plundered from the cities of the plain.
